name: Karina Ranvijei
original_name: カリーナ・ランヴィジェイ
source:
A mysterious Indian. She is the one who gave Akutarou the Indian sex rituals after he lost his confidence and was on the verge of suicide after being attacked by a group of female students. 

She is a mysterious, natural girl who is outgoing, unpredictable, and solitary, and despite being born in India, she speaks fluent Japanese.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=213461&gc=gc]Getchu[/url]]
